checks.detail: public/internal APIs, state owner, syscall owner, three tests, audit, callers, and verifier are present
one focused public header declares heartbeat/file and CLI-report publication
callers can distinguish no rename, rename with uncertain directory durability, and directory-synced publication without parsing text
the exception is deliberately non-final so throw_with_nested preserves the original failing frontier
deterministic failure injection is confined to an internal header
effect classification changes require only noexcept boolean state transitions
publication revokes cleanup permanently and directory durability cannot exist before rename
the source-ownership guard prevents state or syscall logic from returning to anonsync_core_lib
the pure classifier and syscall owner have no reverse core dependency
heartbeat and operator CLI call the same separately owned implementation
temp basename binds destination, process, and monotone call nonce rather than shared payload bytes
every POSIX parent component is inspected and opened without link following, then the exact terminal directory is re-proven before rename and after directory sync
each writer reserves its own 0600 entry with openat(O_EXCL) and retries only collisions
existing symlinks and non-regular final entries are rejected relative to the pinned directory
short writes and EINTR are handled and the temp inode is synced before rename
device/inode identity, exclusive linkage, and private mode are re-proven before publication
source and destination names are resolved under the same pinned directory descriptor
rename and directory fsync advance allocation-free state before any injectable callback
preflight, write, sync, rename, already-typed callback, and close failures share one typed composition boundary
failure cleanup requires exact inode evidence and a state token permanently revoked by rename
threads, forked processes, complete-payload linearization, legacy-owner preservation, path types, mode, and residue are covered
the no-filesystem test proves all three outcomes, cleanup revocation, idempotence, and exception compatibility
each completed effect is interrupted by a thrown exception and checked for outcome, visible generation, nested cause, and cleanup
a parent detached after the pre-rename check is re-observed only after the pinned directory has been synced, so the call fails with the exact completed-effect outcome
a fresh child terminates at every frontier and the parent classifies old-final/temp versus new-final/no-temp state
configure-time no-core dependency guard covers the classifier, syscall owner, and all focused proofs
classifier, implementation, and all regression executables receive ASan/UBSan instrumentation and link flags
CTest registers the race/path corpus, pure model, cutpoint oracle, and structural audit
package verification cannot silently omit the API, model, observer, syscall owner, tests, or audit
the audit itself contains substantive architecture, transition-order, exception, crash, and cleanup checks
